For the point with \(x=-\frac{2}{\sqrt3}\):
\[
y=\frac{-\frac{2}{\sqrt3}+\sqrt3}{\sqrt3}
=\frac{\frac{1}{\sqrt3}}{\sqrt3}
=\frac13.
\]
So the two points are \((2\sqrt3,3)\) and \(\left(-\frac{2}{\sqrt3},\frac13\right)\).

With \(F=(0,1)\):
\[
|AF|=\sqrt{(2\sqrt3)^2+(3-1)^2}=\sqrt{12+4}=4,
\]
\[
|BF|=\sqrt{\left(-\frac{2}{\sqrt3}\right)^2+\left(\frac13-1\right)^2}
=\sqrt{\frac43+\frac49}
=\sqrt{\frac{16}{9}}
=\frac43.
\]
Thus,
\[
\frac{|AF|}{|BF|}=\frac{4}{\frac43}=3.
\]

\[
\boxed{3}
\]
